messages:
anya: quick customer report - require('redwood-sdk') fails in their CI (node14). stack shows "Cannot find module".
frank: which sdk version? any recent packaging changes?
anya: sdk@6.5.0. package.json switched to exports-only with wildcards; no top-level main or explicit require condition.
mike: Node14 resolver behavior is funky with conditional exports. even though default falls back to cjs in some cases, many packagers/electron/hoisting edgecases still fail.
frank: short-term fix: publish a patch that adds a top-level "main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs", and add an explicit "require" entry in exports for the bare import. also set "types" to "dist/index.d.ts" at package root.
anya: can we also add a tiny smoke test in samples that runs `node -e "require('redwood-sdk')"` on node14 to catch regressions?
mike: yes. I'll open a PR to add main/require/types + node14 smoke test and a one-line README note recommending node16+ for ESM-first consumers.
oss-bot: CI alert: samples/linux-node14 smoke failing - job 7721.
frank: long-term: add a devex doc with recommended package.json pattern for libraries shipping ESM/CJS + TS types, include exports examples and typesVersions snippet.
anya: thanks, please loop me in the PR and I'll update the onboarding quickstart to show both import/require examples. :thumbsup:
